parameters.content:
## Scheduler entry (StateScheduler)
Runs every minute and accepts an internal passthrough kick. Product time is restricted to whole calendar days 1/3/7/14; minute leases are queue mechanics only.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | Scheduler Entry | StateScheduler

parameters.content:
## State indexing (QdrantOutbox)
Outbox lease, direct loader, exact receipt, then complete or fail CAS. One deterministic point is processed per call.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | Qdrant Outbox | QdrantOutbox

parameters.content:
## Decisions (Decision)
A bounded all-principals RPC creates no more than one daily decision for each principal local date.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Decision | Decision

parameters.content:
## Action delivery (Delivery)
Reserve and lease are separate from Telegram delivery and separate confirm or fail. Evaluation exists only after confirmed delivery.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Delivery | Delivery

parameters.content:
## Benefit evaluation (Evaluation)
A due evaluation captures a new snapshot, records observed benefit, and enqueues a summary point. Product delay remains 1/3/7/14 days.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Evaluation | Evaluation

parameters.content:
## Operations (Operations)
Read-only queue and health summaries cover one whole day. Successful Scheduler runs are not retained.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Operations | Operations

parameters.content:
## Scheduler entry (StateScheduler)
Runs every minute and accepts an internal passthrough kick. Product time is restricted to whole calendar days 1/3/7/14; minute leases are queue mechanics only.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | Scheduler Entry | StateScheduler

parameters.content:
## State indexing (QdrantOutbox)
Outbox lease, direct loader, exact receipt, then complete or fail CAS. One deterministic point is processed per call.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | Qdrant Outbox | QdrantOutbox

parameters.content:
## Decisions (Decision)
A bounded all-principals RPC creates no more than one daily decision for each principal local date.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Decision | Decision

parameters.content:
## Action delivery (Delivery)
Reserve and lease are separate from Telegram delivery and separate confirm or fail. Evaluation exists only after confirmed delivery.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Delivery | Delivery

parameters.content:
## Benefit evaluation (Evaluation)
A due evaluation captures a new snapshot, records observed benefit, and enqueues a summary point. Product delay remains 1/3/7/14 days.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Evaluation | Evaluation

parameters.content:
## Operations (Operations)
Read-only queue and health summaries cover one whole day. Successful Scheduler runs are not retained.

nodes.name: Sticky Note | State Operations | Operations
